acceptance.failure: After one outbound and one AbsoluteMove approach, any failed visual gate stops the run. The controller may use at most four visual pulses, beginning with two 0.08 s probes before any larger correction; no preset command, second absolute move or fallback is allowed.
acceptance.success: The final fresh quiet frame reaches overlap at least 0.85 and canonical visual displacement at most 3 px from the baseline.

hypothesis: AbsoluteMove can approach the saved coordinates while bounded visual correction removes its observed residual, without creating or relying on a preset. The outbound visual seed selects the first correction direction.
